usage: Hoi1 means 'to open' and is commonly used when talking about turning on or opening devices or objects.
Hoi1 can be used with computers, phones, doors, and windows to mean 'switch on' or 'open' physically.
Hoi1 can also imply starting or enabling something, like opening an app or turning on a machine.
It is often used in everyday speech because many actions involve 'opening' or 'turning on' things.
Hoi1 is a versatile verb and can be followed by the object that is being opened or turned on.
